Messages.Author: Pat Ricochet
Messages.Body:
Let's say I've got Anneke, Democritus, and Andrea Giovanni.

Anneke Banishes my prey's Sheldon, Lord of the Clog.

Banishment [DS, FN]
Cardtype: Political action
Political Card - Worth 1 Vote. Called by any vampire at +1 stealth.
Choose a younger ready vampire. Successful referendum means that the chosen
vampire is moved to the uncontrolled region (place him or her face down).
The vampire is uncontrolled. The vampire's blood counters, master cards and
minion cards stay with that vampire, with any counters they have on them
(minion cards are out of play as long as the vampire remains uncontrolled).

Democritus calls Might of the Camarilla. The only vampire in my prey's
crypt is Sheldon, now face down.

Might of the Camarilla [AH]
Cardtype: Political Action
Political Card-Worth 1 Vote. Called by any justicar or Inner Circle member
at +1 stealth.
If this <referendum> is successful, each Methuselah chooses one vampire in
his or her <uncontrolled> region and burns him or her.

Andrea Giovanni tries to Daemonically Possess the burned copy of
Sheldon.

Daemonic Possession [FN]
Cardtype: Action
Cost: 2 blood
Discipline: Necromancy
[nec] Only usable when a minion controlled by another Methuselah has been
burned since your last turn. Move that minion from his owner's ash heap to
your ready region, put 1 blood or life from the blood bank on the minion and
tap the minion. You now control the minion.
[NEC] As above, but the minion is untapped.

This doesn't actually work, does it? Although Sheldon was "controlled
... since [my] last turn," and "has been burned since [my] last turn," he
wasn't controlled at the time of burning. I mean, I'd sure like this to
work, but I suspect that it won't. =\

--
Pat Ricochet
Soul Jar'rn Fool of Atlanta

controlled.
